title: Irreducible representations of general linear groups over a local field
course: The local Langlands correspondence for GL_n
proved_here: Jacquet exactness, admissibility, adjunction, block geometric lemma, cuspidal support and finite length (Section1)
Rank-two segment dictionary, Jacquet modules and Steinberg coefficient summation (Sections3–5)
Rank-three constituent structure, multiplicity, unique quotients and genericity (Section6)
Normalized mirabolic derivatives, filtration, Leibniz rule, duality and cuspidal-pair criterion (AppendixA)
All-rank Whittaker uniqueness and irreducible supercuspidal mirabolic restriction (AppendixB)
Distinct-support classification and entire submodule lattice (TheoremsC.2–C.3)
Segment construction and all block Jacquet modules, duals and derivatives (TheoremsC.4–C.5)
Linked overlapping Z-pair theorem and complete two-segment criterion (TheoremC.9 and CorollaryC.10)
not_proved_here: Necessity in general products of three or more Z-segments
General Q-product irreducibility and generic classification
All-rank square-integrable and tempered classifications, including the rank-three temperedness problem

programme_proof_dependencies.title: Smooth local representations and the Hecke-module dictionary
Whittaker models, Kirillov models and the local classification

download_scope: Source and coverage metadata for this lesson only; the linked preceding programme proof modules are not bundled.
